chunks: And it was narrated from Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam that he said:
I saw Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام offering condolences before the burial and after it.

key_terms.بَعْدَهُ: after it, meaning after the burial
key_terms.مُوسَى: Mūsā, referring here to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام
key_terms.هِشَامِ: Hishām, the narrator reporting this account
key_terms.يُعَزِّي: he offered condolences to the bereaved

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to offer condolences both before and after burial in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام offered condolences both before burial and after it. It indicates the permissibility and practice of taʿziyah at both stages of bereavement and reflects compassionate conduct toward the bereaved.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.503 - It was narrated from Hisham ibn al-Hakam that He said:
"I saw Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) offering condolences both before and after the burial."
